name: Party for the Preserves
org: River Trail Nature Center (Forest Preserves of Cook County)
raw:
Party for the Preserves | 2026-09-26 10:30:00 | Celebrate National Public Lands Day at our annual Party for the Preserves. Arrive in the morning and make a toy boat with natural materials and join a ‘regatta’ down the river. Stay until the afternoon to make a “seed bomb” to launch wildflowers into your own yard. All ages.
Zombie Hunting! 
Become a citizen scientist and learn about the spooky zombie insects of Illinois! Neuroparasitologist Dr. William C. Beckerson of Lake Forest College leads a local expedition to search for “zombie beetles” at River Trail Nature Center. As part of the team, you can help document and collect zombie insects for real genetics research! 
More information can be found here: https://www.zombeetles.com/citizen-science 
Audience: ages 8 to Adult 

10:30 am–11:30 am: Stick Boat Regatta
11:30 am–1:30 pm: Zombie Hunting! with Dr. William C. Beckerson
1–2 pm: Make a Seed Bomb | cost:Free | url:https://fpdcc.com/event/party-for-the-preserves-3/
